meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Egypt (unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid Civil Law (French/Napoleonic-based codified law) with Islamic Sharia as the principal source of legislation per Article 2 of the 2014 Constitution; unitary national system

Egypt–United States Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 1986, in force)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering, as amended by Law No. 36 of 2014 and Law No. 154 of 2019, together with its Executive Regulations (Prime Ministerial Decree No. 95 of 2003, as amended); Law No. 159 of 1981 (Companies Law); Law No. 72 of 2017 (Investment Law) and Executive Regulations (Prime Ministerial Decree No. 2310 of 2017); Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) customer due diligence and AML/CFT regulations; Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) standards on UBO record-keeping; Egypt's FATF and MENAFATF obligations. Construction and real-estate dealing enterprises are expressly treated as Designated Non-Financial Businesses and Professions (DNFBPs) under the 2019 AML amendments.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution of the foreign sole shareholder/parent authorizing incorporation of the Egyptian LLC and appointment of initial managers
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or corporate secretary of the foreign entity in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Egypt is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; chain: foreign notarization, authentication by the competent home-country authority, legalization by the Embassy/Consulate of Egypt, then sworn Arabic translation in Egypt)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry/competent registrar of the foreign jurisdiction (e.g., Companies House, Secretary of State)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Hague Apostille unavailable; same three-stage chain plus Arabic translation)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency / register of directors and officers of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registered agent or corporate secretary of the foreign entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Hague Apostille unavailable; same three-stage chain plus Arabic translation)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies of all ultimate beneficial owners, shareholders and prospective managers
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Hague Apostille unavailable; same three-stage chain plus Arabic translation)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special Power of Attorney granting the Egyptian incorporation attorney authority to file, sign and manage the GAFI One-Stop Shop application
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Hague Apostille unavailable; same three-stage chain plus Arabic translation)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all shareholders, directors, managers, signatories and ultimate beneficial owners against: (i) OFAC SDN List and Consolidated Non-SDN List; (ii) UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (iii) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; (iv) UK HMT OFSI sanctions list; (v) Egyptian EMLCU money-laundering suspect database and CBE anti-fraud records; (vi) World Bank Group Sanctions System debarment list applicable to construction/EPC contractors. Positive PEP or sanctions hits trigger enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth documentation and senior-management approval under Law No. 80 of 2002, Articles 8-9, with mandatory Suspicious Transaction Report filing to the EMLCU where warranted. Egypt remained under FATF enhanced monitoring from February 2023 until its delisting in February 2025; the resulting FATF-aligned UBO transparency, registration and record-keeping standards are the operative compliance baseline. The proposed activity qualifies as Low_Risk_Standard for banking purposes, yet the statutory DNFBP classification of construction enterprises preserves full CDD obligations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI One-Stop Shop (OSS) electronic system - General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (www.gafi.gov.eg / www.invest-in-egypt.gov.eg), integrated with the Commercial Registry of the Ministry of Trade and Industry; name examination is performed against the national commercial names database and the GAFI reserved-name stock.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names of Egyptian LLCs must be rendered in Arabic script under the Companies Law (Law No. 159 of 1981); the Arabic name constitutes the sole statutory identity. A Latin-script transliteration may be lodged concurrently as a translation but carries no independent legal effect and must correspond exactly to the approved Arabic name. The name must not mislead as to the corporate object, must not conflict with an existing registered or reserved name (script, phonetic and similarity checks), and must end with the mandatory suffix equivalent to 'LLC' (Arabic: شركة ذات مسئولية محدودة / 'ذ.م.م').
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Egypt / Arab / Republic / National / Central (require prior Cabinet or ministerial approval)
Islamic / Sharia / Al-Azhar (religiously sensitive, require ministry authorization)
Bank / Insurance / Finance / Investment (require a CBE or FRA operating license)
Military / Army / Police / Armed Forces (sovereign and defense-related, categorically restricted)
International / Global / World (admissible only upon objective proof of cross-border business scope)
Names identical or phonetically/visually similar to existing registered or reserved company names
Names of heads of state, public figures, symbols of state sovereignty, or names violating public order or decency
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon written notification of rejection, the applicant may (i) file a corrected re-application through the GAFI OSS portal within 15 days; (ii) submit a formal administrative grievance to the GAFI Vice-Chairman for Investment Services within 30 days of the rejection notice; or (iii) lodge an annulment action before the Cairo Administrative Court (Court of Administrative Justice) under the Egyptian Administrative Procedure Law. Every rejection must be accompanied by a written justification. A reserved name may be extended for one additional 90-day term by filing a timely extension request with the GAFI OSS before expiry, provided the incorporation file remains active and no conflicting third-party right has intervened.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as a standard solution. GAFI One-Stop Shop requirements mandate a physical registered address in Egypt evidenced by a notarized tenancy contract or proof of ownership, a utility bill and photographic documentation; the address is published in the Commercial Registry and the Official Gazette. For the offshore wind marine piling industry, a fully serviced business-center suite with active management presence and accessible books and records may be tolerated as an administrative site, but the Egyptian Tax Authority and GAFI expect demonstrable operational substance at the project or administrative base within six months of incorporation. Any relocation of the registered office requires Commercial Registry re-registration and, if across governorates, prior authority approval.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate: approximately 20% within the first 12 months post-incorporation. Unannounced on-site verifications by the Egyptian Tax Authority, GAFI and Commercial Registry inspectors are risk-based; the probability rises to 30-40% if the LLC is a new foreign-owned entity in the construction sector, contracts with public-sector or SCZONE counterparties, or maintains its address within serviced-business-center clusters associated with non-operating shell entities. Full occupancy, staff presence and commercial books must be evidenced; material deviation from the declared commercial substance endangers the commercial registration, tax identification number and bank account standing.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended by Law No. 4 of 2018), Articles 5 through 18 (formation formalities, LLC registration, and share capital); Investment Law No. 72 of 2017, Articles 1 to 13; Executive Regulations of the Investment Law, Decree No. 2310 of 2017; and Civil Code notarization requirements.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI), Companies Registration Department and Commercial Registry, operating through the One-Stop Shop and the GAFI e-Service Portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Association / Incorporation Contract (Aqd Taasis) filed with GAFI and the Commercial Registry, accompanied by notarization and bank capital deposit evidence.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to an LLC; however, the full subscribed share capital must be contributed by the quotaholders and deposited in a designated Egyptian bank escrow account, with the bank capital deposit certificate attached to the incorporation application before the commercial registration certificate is issued.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporation documents as submitted to GAFI be ratified and the Articles of Association approved. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the subscribed share capital be allotted pro rata to the quotaholders, with paid-up deposits held in the LLC bank account. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office be fixed at the address in the Articles of Association, Cairo, Egypt. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the following officers be appointed: Chief Executive Officer, Chief Financial Officer, and Corporate Secretary, with full authority to execute regulatory filings and banking mandates. RESOLVED, that the chairperson affix the seal as required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company name reservation and GAFI e-registration account opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop / GAFI e-Service Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application on the GAFI portal; verify that no identical or nearly identical name exists in the Commercial Registry; upload quotaholder identity documents and activate electronic signature credentials; obtain the name reservation receipt prior to drafting the Articles.
required_dossiers: Proposed Arabic and English company name list
Passport and proof of address of each founding quotaholder
Executed memorandum of intent among quotaholders
Notarized power of attorney if filed by an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, submit an administrative objection to GAFI Customer Care within 15 days with a secondary name list; GAFI must issue a reasoned decision after the review, or the applicant may amend and resubmit the reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, bilingual certification, and notarization of the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI legal assistance desk and Egyptian Public Notary / licensed attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Finalize the incorporation contract in Arabic with a certified English translation; ensure the corporate object clause expressly covers marine heavy driving, offshore wind monopile foundations, and steel structural fabrication; execute the signing formalities before the public notary and obtain notarization stamps and certified transaction slips.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Association in Arabic and certified English translation
Name reservation receipt
Copies of quotaholders' national IDs and passport pages
List of board of managers with names, capacities, and specimen signatures
Written consent of every quotaholder to the Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary returns the file for missing consents or defective translation, rectify the drafting, re-execute the signatures, and pay the incremental notarial fee; no fresh GAFI submission is required where the substantive content is unchanged.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of the corporate escrow account and deposit of subscribed capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian commercial bank (corporate branch) supervised by the Central Bank of Egypt
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate escrow account in the name of the LLC under formation; deposit the entire paid-up subscription amount from each quotaholder; obtain an initial capital deposit certificate expressly naming the LLC and stating the deposited amount, which remains escrowed until the incorporation certificate is issued and the account mandate is activated.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association
Preliminary tax identification form and quotaholder passports/IDs
Board of managers resolution for bank account operation
Ministry of Interior security clearance documents when requested by the bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank exercises enhanced due diligence, supply audited source-of-funds statements and an amended banking resolution; alternatively, transfer the deposit to the lead transaction bank with the project sponsor's consent and adjust the banking mandate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of the incorporation file and issuance of the incorporation and commercial registration certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Companies Registration Department / Commercial Registry, One-Stop Shop
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Assemble the complete electronic and physical incorporation file on the GAFI portal; pay the official state fees, stamp duties, and publication fees; obtain the signed incorporation certificate and commercial registration certificate evidencing the legal personality and commercial registration number of the LLC.
required_dossiers: Notarized and bilingual Articles of Association
Bank capital deposit certificate
Name reservation receipt
Board of managers acceptance and appointment consents
GAFI application cover sheet and fee payment vouchers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, file the corrected documents electronically within 30 days; where GAFI does not act within the statutory review period, the applicant may rely on deemed approval or escalate via written complaint to the GAFI Deputy Chief Executive Officer for registration affairs.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax card and national identification number registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), through the GAFI One-Stop Shop and the competent taxpayer reception office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the LLC as a legal person with the ETA; obtain the tax card and the National Identification Number; complete withholding tax, VAT, stamp duty, and salary tax registration under Law No. 67 of 2016 and its executive regulations.
required_dossiers: Incorporation certificate and commercial registration certificate
Notarized Articles of Association
Lease contract or title document for the registered office
Board of managers ID copies and specimen signatures
Bank account statement and capital deposit certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ETA requests supplemental premises or civil records, provide the notarized lease and governorate land-use certificate; any refusal may be appealed by filing a summary grievance with the competent ETA office within 30 days of the refusal notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Social insurance and labor office registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI) and the Ministry of Manpower Labor Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the LLC as an employer with NOSI and obtain the employer registration number; register all founding and hired personnel for social insurance; notify the Labor Office of the workforce plan and submit the occupational health and safety preliminary declaration.
required_dossiers: Commercial registry certificate
Tax card and National Identification Number certificate
List of founding directors and contracted employees
Lease or title documents for the workplace
Workforce plan and payroll sample
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If NOSI or the Labor Office imposes delayed registration penalties, file an administrative appeal with the NOSI contributions department and supply certified payroll listings and employment commencement declarations to correct the effective registration date.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA), Ministry of Trade and Industry
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial Operating License for the manufacture, fabrication, and assembly of steel monopile foundations and supporting marine offshore wind installation structures, issued pursuant to Industrial Licensing Law No. 15 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA), Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B - medium to large-scale metal fabrication and marine installation support facility, requiring a scoped Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Report; a Full EIA Report is required where the site is located in a coastal or environmentally sensitive zone.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Industrial wastewater: Law No. 48 of 1982 and Decree No. 44 of 2000, with pH 6.0-9.5, BOD not exceeding 40 mg/L, COD not exceeding 80 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 60 mg/L, oil and grease not exceeding 15 mg/L, and heavy metals below permit thresholds; process VOCs must be captured and treated using best available techniques; ambient air, stack emissions, and noise must comply with Law No. 4 of 1994 as amended by Law No. 9 of 2009; hazardous waste storage, movement, and disposal require an EEAA permit under the applicable waste management regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Authority (Ministry of Interior) fire safety and civil defense clearance for the fabrication yard, marine laydown area, and jetty facilities; structural load inspection and crane/lifting equipment certification by an approved engineering consultant registered with the respective governorate; and an occupational health and safety workplace clearance certificate from the Ministry of Manpower under Labor Law No. 12 of 2003, covering medical fitness, emergency evacuation, fall protection, and crane operation zones.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) — official national tax authority; portal: www.eta.gov.eg (electronic services for TIN issuance, VAT filing, and e-invoicing).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity conducting taxable activities in Egypt must first obtain a Tax Identification Number (TIN) from the Egyptian Tax Authority by filing the standard registration application, submitting constitutional documents (e.g., certificate of incorporation, foreign registration certificates), notarized Arabic translations, evidence of the Egyptian permanent establishment or local branch registration with the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI), and any required commercial registry extracts. The ETA issues the TIN after verification; VAT registration is effected simultaneously when the entity exceeds the statutory threshold or voluntarily elects registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egypt does not provide U.S.-style check-the-box elections. LLCs are taxed at the entity level under Law No. 91 of 2005 (Income Tax Law). Elections available include free-zone status with qualifying tax exemptions under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017, special economic zone (SEZ) incentives, and treaty-based permanent establishment determinations through the competent authority procedure. Hybrid mismatch adjustments are available under the tax rules aligned with BEPS Action 2 where the law permits recharacterization.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable turnover threshold for mandatory VAT registration (non-resident suppliers with an Egyptian economic presence are also required to register).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egypt operates a mandatory real-time electronic invoicing and clearance system administered by the ETA. B2B invoices must be transmitted to the ETA’s e-invoicing portal via secured API integration in a specified JSON/XML schema; each invoice receives a unique UUID and QR code after validation. The system performs real-time fiscal clearance and rejects non-conforming invoices. Foreign entities with Egyptian VAT obligations must integrate through approved SDKs or service providers.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exported outside Egypt are generally zero-rated for Egyptian VAT provided they leave the country under customs supervision within the legally permitted timeframes. Offshore services supplied to non-residents for use wholly outside Egypt, including marine construction and installation services for offshore wind turbine foundations, may qualify as zero-rated services when the benefit is enjoyed outside Egypt and the exporter retains contemporaneous evidence. A written export declaration and compliance with the ETA’s export documentation rules are required; services must be performed physically outside Egypt or directly in relation to exported goods to be eligible.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA may conduct post-export audits up to ten years from the filing date in cases of fraud. False zero-rating claims trigger retrospective VAT assessments at 14%, an additional penalty of up to 100% of the evaded tax, disciplinary fines under VAT Law No. 67 of 2016 (as amended) of not less than EGP 25,000 and up to EGP 500,000, and potential criminal liability including imprisonment. Where foreign exchange proceeds are not repatriated within the 180-day CBE directive, tax authorities may deny the foreign currency certificate, invalidate zero-rating substantiation, and claw back the VAT plus penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) and the Egyptian Exchange Control Authority (within CBE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt operates a controlled but generally current-account convertible regime under Law No. 194 of 2020 encompassing the Foreign Exchange Regulation Law. The Egyptian Pound (EGP) is not freely convertible offshore; onshore convertibility is maintained through CBE-licensed banks. Capital account transactions, including foreign direct investment equity injections, are convertible upon submission of legally required documentation and CBE reporting, but remain subject to prudential gates and anti-money laundering checks. Profit remittances are permitted for legally established foreign-owned entities, provided the company has audited financial statements, a valid tax clearance certificate from the Egyptian Tax Authority, proof of capital entry through a bank account, and no outstanding unresolved exchange-control violations. Dividend and profit transfers are processed at the prevailing market rate with straightforward administrative review; however, historical periods of FX scarcity have resulted in queueing for hard currency, so pre-approval and early application are recommended for large distributions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under CBE rules, all export receipts must be repatriated to Egypt and credited to an Egyptian bank account within a maximum of 90 days from the date of shipment or customs clearance, as indicated on the export documents. Exporters must submit customs declarations, invoices, and proof of ship arrival to the bank. There is currently no blanket statutory mandatory conversion of export proceeds into EGP under the liberalized FX regime following the 2016 float; exporters may retain foreign currency in approved accounts or convert to EGP at the market rate. However, the CBE reserves the right to introduce temporary surrender requirements (historically ranging from 50% to 75%) during foreign exchange stress periods, and banks may impose their own internal conversion thresholds for consolidation of liquidity. Full surrender obligations are typically triggered if the exporter utilises subsidised financing or concessional credit lines.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign Currency Denominated Account / Operational Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low viability. Egypt does not recognise offshore digital EMI (Electronic Money Institution) licenses. Any entity wishing to provide payment or e-money services must obtain a license from the CBE under the E-Money Regulation Law and the Payment Systems Law. An offshore EMI cannot open a corporate bank account or gateway to Egyptian clearing systems without a local licensed partner or a CBE-approved branch. For a single-purpose EG LLC, the incremental cost and time of establishing a licensed EMI are unjustified. Consequently, all treasury operations must be routed through regulated Egyptian commercial banks.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Egyptian commercial banks generally mandate an in-person interview with the ultimate beneficial owner, at least one authorised director, and the CFO/signatories during the initial corporate onboarding. Remote or e-KYC onboarding is not fully permitted for foreign-owned companies without a pre-existing relationship with the bank's international branch or a substantial account balance. For foreign directors, the bank accepts a notarised board resolution, power of attorney, passport copies, and proof of residential address; however, the bank's compliance officer must still conduct a live video call and may require an in-person visit to Cairo for the first account activation. In practice, physical presence of the Egyptian legal representative or a director appointed under Egyptian law is required at the bank branch for the account opening signature verification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign company with an industry classified as heavy construction / infrastructure (ISIC 4290) without prior remittance history
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Government-issued identification and passport copies of all UBOs and directors, valid commercial registry extract from Egyptian General Authority for Investment (GAFI), certified memoranda and articles of association, board resolution appointing signatories, audited financial statements or parent guarantee, and a detailed business narrative describing the offshore wind turbine piling project, including the ultimate project Owner and the contractual supply chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection from a jurisdiction perceived as low-tax or having no physical substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Evidence of the parent entity's economic substance (eg, physical office lease, employee list, tax returns, bank statements showing operational activity), a letter of explanation from the parent's auditor, export or project contract with a respectable counterparty, and clarity on the source of funds through notarised board minutes approving the capital allocation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large single deposit or initial wire exceeding USD 1,000,000 without prior notification
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Pre-transaction rationale, signed loan or contribution deeds, the underlying Suez Canal Economic Zone or Ministry of Electricity project agreement, evidence of the transaction's commercial purpose, and duly completed CBE foreign exchange declaration forms (eg, Form 103 or its successor for inward transfers).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payment instruction relating to political or military-related project counterparties, even if only indirectly
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed Compliance review letter confirming no sanctioned or restricted persons appear in project participants, full shareholder and UBO certification, end-beneficiary of each payment, copies of licenses issued by the Egyptian Ministry of Defence or Military Production if applicable, and an undertaking to provide periodic compliance updates.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound foreign capital contributions and shareholder loans are routed through an onshore Egyptian bank using SWIFT MT103 or MT202 wire transfers. The remitting bank must include a purpose code describing the transaction as either 'Foreign Direct Investment – Share Capital Contribution' or 'Shareholder Loan' in accordance with CBE's Institutional Framework for Foreign Exchange Declaration. Prior to sending funds, the EG LLC must obtain a CBE-approved inward remittance number from the receiving bank by submitting the board resolution, signed subscription agreement, and the company's commercial registration. For amounts exceeding USD 100,000 or the EGP equivalent, a CBE foreign exchange declaration form must be filed by the receiving bank within 30 days. Funds are initially credited to the capital escrow account unless an operational account designation is permitted. Transfer instructions must specify the beneficiary bank's SWIFT code, account number, and reference 'OFFSHORE_WIND_PILINGS_EG_LLC_CAP2024'. The underlying project agreement with a recognised Ministry or utility should be annexed for smooth compliance.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade payments for procured raw steel, marine equipment, and subcontracted installation services must be executed using SWIFT MT103 (for direct supplier payments) and documentary Letters of Credit (Commercial LC) issued by an Egyptian commercial bank upon presentation of shipping and customs documents. For LC issuances, EG LLC must provide the commercial invoiced value, transport documents, and proforma invoice to the issuing bank. The bank will then issue an irrevocable, at-sight LC under ICC Uniform Customs and Practice (UCP 600) terms. Outbound trade payments require CBE Form 103/104 filings and are scrutinised for currency conversion requests; EG LLC can request EGP conversion at the market rate or use the foreign currency from the company's retained export proceeds account. For non-trade disbursements, such as subcontracting fees and service payments, SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'IS28' (Contractor Services) is acceptable; however, a tax clearance from the Egyptian Tax Authority and value-added tax certificates must accompany the instructions.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forward Contracts (delivery-based) with CBE-licensed counterparty banks for up to 12-month maturities
Cross-Currency Swaps between USD and EGP, and between USD and Euro, where the onshore counterparty is a CBE-licensed bank and the transaction is evidenced by an ISDA Master Agreement
FX Options (plain-vanilla calls/puts) with a CBE-licensed bank, subject to a minimum notional of USD 250,000 and a term not exceeding 12 months

NDF (Non-Deliverable Forward) contracts with offshore counterparties, permitted strictly for hedge accounting purposes and prohibited for speculative uses; any NDF entered by an Egyptian onshore entity requires CBE approval and cannot be used to circumvent Egyptian exchange controls

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return and audited financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months of the fiscal year-end (December 31 for calendar-year entities)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of EGP 1,000 per month (up to 10 months) plus 20% of tax due; interest on understated tax at market rate; criminal prosecution for persistent non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual filed copy of audited financial statements and shareholders' meeting minutes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Corporate Registry Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after approval by the shareholders' meeting (AGM must be held within 6 months after year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty up to EGP 1,500; administrative suspension of commercial registration; blocking of government-issued certificates

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation within 60 days of the registration anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to EGP 100,000 and/or up to 3 months imprisonment for responsible officers; administrative strike-off of the company from the UBO register

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial Registry five-year renewal declaration and fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry Authority (Ministry of Trade and Industry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Any time during the 6 months before the expiration of the 5-year registration term; annual interim confirmation is required under the local municipality commercial license
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative strike-off of trade name and registration; inability to execute contracts or obtain permits; reactivation fee doubles the original renewal amount

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual municipal commercial license fee declaration and payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary date of the original commercial license issue (annual)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Interest of 1% per month on unpaid fee; forced closure of the registered office; suspension of Municipality-issued compliance certificate

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for all Egyptian limited liability companies regardless of size, turnover, or capital; an accredited Egyptian auditor must certify financial statements and the audit report must accompany the tax return and GAFI filings
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) – substantially converged with IFRS; entities with listed instruments or regulated by the Financial Regulatory Authority must apply full IFRS

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every shareholding transfer must be recorded in the Register of Members and reflected in the Beneficial Ownership Register. The company must file an annual confirmation with GAFI listing all current UBOs, including natural persons owning more than 25%, senior managing officers, or indirect control holders. Failure to update the UBO Register within 30 days of any change is a separate offense punishable by administrative penalties and criminal liability of directors.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 500–2,000 USD per annum (Cairo/Greater Cairo premium; provincial rates lower)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 3,000–8,000 USD per annum for an offshore construction/heavy engineering LLC with project-financed operations

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Investment Law No. 72/2017 allows a 50% deduction of eligible investment costs (capped at 50% of taxable income), reducing the effective rate to approximately 11.25% for qualifying projects. Free-zone entities under Law No. 83/2002 may apply 0% CIT on export-oriented profits. Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) licensed projects could qualify for an additional up-to-50% tax reduction for 5–7 years. Accelerated depreciation applies for marine heavy-driving equipment, jack-up vessels, and monopile installation assets. The offshore wind sector is expressly treated as a promoted industrial activity for such incentives. The utilization of tax incentives requires an advance investment registration certificate and annual substance verification.
